pr_title: Need to use GL_RGB8 and GL_RGBA8 as the internal format for GLES2
pr_body:
Found out that using GL_RGB doesn't always properly get resolved and gave problems when the render buffer was used in for instance OpenGL. Also the texture definition didn't apply the correct formatting, not sure of the impact of that.

Anyway, using GL_RGB8 (and also using GL_RGBA8 instead of GL_RGBA) for the internal format seems to be the correct thing to do.

Fixes #33705
And https://github.com/GodotVR/godot_openvr/issues/70
pr_comments:
After looking a little bit I realized that ES 2.0 base spec doesn't guaranteed that sized internal formats are available. 

For now maybe we need to do GL_RGB8 on desktop and GL_RGB on mobile (and maybe web)

issue_context.title: GLES2 GL_RGB buffer breaks OpenVR
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
Commit # 35444576ff684aebb0133d46495be85d3d434900 but seems to have changed in Godot 3.2 some time ago

**OS/device including version:**
Tested on Windows, but any OpenVR capable OS will exhibit this

**Issue description:**
In Godot 3.2 the code here was changed:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/drivers/gles2/rasterizer_storage_gles2.cpp#L4587
We now create a GL_RGB buffer if we're not using a transparent background. In Godot 3.1 we always created an GL_RGBA buffer regardless. 

When sending the render output to OpenVR, GL_RGB is not a supported format, likely because the 24bit color buffer is more inefficient then a 32bit color buffer (data alignment wise)

I'm wondering if there is a good reason to use GL_RGB here other than slightly less memory usage (if the hardware doesn't decide to use a 32bit based buffer anyway)?

I'd hate to introduce a new switch to force GL_RGBA...

While I think its unrelated it is also interesting to note that the texture object returned for the viewport always assumes GL_RGBA:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/drivers/gles2/rasterizer_storage_gles2.cpp#L4679

**Steps to reproduce:**
Run the OpenVR demo project in GLES2 mode (https://github.com/godotvr/godot_openvr)

**Minimal reproduction project:**
https://github.com/godotvr/godot_openvr
